title: UCOS Ω∞ Universal Artifact
description: A single artifact registered in the Universal Master Knowledge Book. Every reachable artifact in the UCOS Ω∞ ecosystem has exactly one Universal Artifact record. The Universal Artifact ID is an append-only overlay identifier; it never renames or renumbers the artifact's native program identifier.

universal_id.description: Globally unique, immutable, never-reused Universal Artifact ID.

native_id.description: The artifact's own program identifier (e.g. ENG-000, ARCH-DATA-001, CAT-000, IMP-014, RUNTIME-001, RAT-11). Preserved verbatim; never modified by the UKB.

description.description: Short description of the artifact's purpose.

page_start.description: First Universal Page Number (UPN) allocated to this artifact.

page_end.description: Last Universal Page Number (UPN) allocated to this artifact.

version.description: Semantic version of the artifact content.

parent.description: Universal Artifact ID of the parent (Volume/Program/predecessor container). Null only for UCOS-BOOK-000000.

dependencies.description: Universal Artifact IDs this artifact depends on (Depends-On edges).

program.description: Program the artifact belongs to (e.g. CONSOLIDATION, EES, IMP, ARCH, CAT, REF, GEN, ENG, RUNTIME, UKB, SOURCE).

path.description: Repository-relative direct link to the artifact file.

return_link.description: Repository-relative return link (default: the Master Index).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the artifact file at registration time (integrity / change detection).

traceability.description: Requirement to Operations traceability chain references (Universal Artifact IDs or external markers).
